research_usage.cap_enforcement: Admission-only: no further caller starts once prior usage reaches cap. An already-started caller can exceed the aggregate. Not a hard token limit.

limitations: Two familiar synthetic Python services; one observation per case/arm. Descriptive elimination screen, no statistical significance or generalization claim.
Current control interleaved; native and legacy comparisons historical with different serving/cache conditions. No exact subscription-quota claim.
All started trials retained; no retries/replacements. Product default and all49 promoted behavior files unchanged.
A smaller instruction file alone does not establish lower whole-caller usage.

observed_mechanism.interpretation: The shorter instruction did not prevent duplicate context reads. The added turns replayed cached input, increasing raw tokens. One paired observation does not prove a universal causal effect.

local_closure.meaning: The experiment and evidence checks passed. This does not establish a product efficiency improvement; that objective remains unmet.
